g.desc: J14 duplicates J5 BEFORE D3: 1 = external +12 V, 2 = coil return.

g.text: Shared source: approximately 0.20 A with five 12 V G5Q-1 coils; allow >=0.3 A.

g.text: No connection to battery or SYSTEM_RET. Motor relay suppression remains external.

g.desc: No connection to battery or SYSTEM_RET. Motor relay suppression remains external.
